additional_info.subject: RE: ID0372201-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000420] Credit Card Reader not illuminated CRM:01811000202
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well,
During authentication, when you tap on the CCV CORE-A10, the command from DQ11 in KF2 mode should be sent to the CCV EN terminal. There may be a loose connection from the KF2 module causing issues.
Could you please check the following steps if we receive the command from KF2 module.
When you are in payment mode (when the sign on the payment terminal should light up), ensure you have a voltage of 24VDC arriving at the connectors.
Disconnect the connectors and measure the LED resistance between the CCV EN and GND PIN.
If the resistance value is around 500 Ohms, the LED is good.
If the resistance value is very high, consider replacing the screen.
Kindly refer the snapshot for the reference,
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar

Yunex

Ich hoffe, dass die Umsatzausfälle dadurch nicht zu drastisch ausfallen.
Sobald Ramona wieder zurück ist, ist das der erste Einsatz, der durchgeführt wird. (Montag, 30.09.)
